Ledger files are decision_log.jsonl, claims_ledger.jsonl, evidence_ledger.jsonl under /memory/ledgers/ (note: this wake read them directly as decision_log.jsonl/claims_ledger.jsonl/approvals_pending.jsonl/approvals_resolved.jsonl -- filenames confirmed working). harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan/classify.classify/citations.validate all take text (pub.body), not the Publication object; citations.validate also needs a harness.ledger.Ledger built from evidence_ledger.jsonl. citations.validate.strip_code() removes backtick-wrapped URLs before matching, so always cite as markdown links or bare https:// URLs, never backtick-wrapped. citations.validate matches on exact URL string -- check evidence_ledger.jsonl entries with kind=='fetch' for the precise URL string before linking, and make sure every fetched source you cite in prose actually has a markdown link in the body (a source mentioned only in prose without a link won't be picked up by citations.validate, as happened on this wake's first pipeline run). classify.classify's looks_like_org() checks only the first word of a capitalised-word run against NOT_AN_ORG, so any capitalised multi-word phrase sharing a sentence with a negative term can false-positive -- split the sentence rather than misquote evidence if this happens.
